title: 2026 GCF marine-freight international-average and WTT QA

sources.title: 2026 Government greenhouse gas conversion factors for company reporting: Methodology paper

facts.source_fact: Other marine-freight CO2 factors use representative cargo-ship efficiency estimates rather than RoPax methodology.
The cargo-ship efficiency basis comes from an IMO greenhouse-gas report.
The published marine-freight factors represent international-average vessel characteristics and loading factors.
The methodology notes that equivalent UK-specific datasets are not available.
Marine CH4 and N2O factors remain based on the 2021 methodology lineage.
Marine CH4 and N2O values have been updated from AR4 to AR5 GWP values.
Sea-transport WTT factors cover fuel production and distribution before ship use.
Marine WTT factors use ratios between direct CO2 factors and relevant fuel WTT factors.
The sea-transport section contains Scope 3 reporting factors.
International-average marine factors must not be represented as measured emissions for a specific vessel, route or parcel.
